=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/claude_anthropic_relay.py:105 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `_reject` reads `self.command` unconditionally, raising `AttributeError` when the handler has not been initialized with that attribute.
  WHY: The CI-verified test `test_rejection_still_attempts_reply_when_timeout_reset_fails` (tests/test_claude_anthropic_relay.py:228-238) constructs a `Relay` via `object.__new__(relay.Relay)`, sets only `connection` and a mocked `send_error`, then calls `handler._reject(400)`. The first line of `_reject` evaluates `self.command`, which is not set on the bare instance, so it raises `AttributeError: 'Relay' object has no attribute 'command'` before the rejection reply is even attempted.
- scripts/claude_anthropic_relay.py:105
  PROBLEM: `self._request_body_consumed` is also read without `getattr`, so a caller that has not gone through `BaseHTTPRequestHandler.parse_request()` or that bails before `do_POST` initializes the flag may hit `AttributeError` before the rejection reply is sent.
  WHY: The suggested fix covers this access with `getattr(self, "_request_body_consumed", True)`, matching the existing `getattr(self, "_unread_body_bytes", int(length))` style.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ---
